title: Rapid Quantum Network Simulation Design with a Path to Scalable Execution
problem: Quantum network simulation frameworks difficult to work with and performance-limited due to serial nature; SeQUeNCe scalability not proven.
motivation: Need user-friendly framework for rapid quantum network experiment design with path to scalable execution.
method: BISQIT uses a block-diagram framework (visual representations of how components connect and exchange data) to make quantum network design more intuitive and manageable. The framework creates a documented migration path that allows designs to transition from BISQIT into SeQUeNCe, a production quantum network simulator. Scalability is validated through testing on Frontier, a supercomputer, demonstrating the approach can handle realistic simulation scales.
key_novelty: The key novelty is a block-diagram design framework for quantum networks that provides a practical migration path to production simulators, demonstrated through integration with SeQUeNCe.
contributions: BISQIT block-diagram framework for quantum experiment design
